newsitem.title: USA: VWR Scientific sees Q4 below expectations.
newsitem.headline: VWR Scientific sees Q4 below expectations.

text.p: VWR Scientific Products Corp said on Wednesday that it expects fourth quarter and 1996 financial results to fall "significantly below expectations."
Wall Street analysts had a fourth quarter consensus earnings estimate of $0.18 a share and $0.60 a share for the year, according to First Call.
In 1995's fourth quarter, the company reported a loss of $0.03 a share and a 1995 profit of $0.13 a share.
Company representatives were unable to give a specific range for the results to be issued in late February.
Full year 1996 earnings and earnings per share will show significant increases over 1995 results, VWR Scientific said.

VWR Scientific said fourth quarter results will include charges from integrating its Baxter Industrial Distribution unit and will also reflect soft demand from electronics production customers, due to weather-related and vacation shutdowns.
